node: Cloud AI platforms, enterprise automation software, data platforms, copilots, and agentic workflows
summary: Expanded the direct public-company universe for the node around enterprise AI deployment friction: hyperscale cloud platforms that package AI infrastructure into enterprise services, and workflow/CRM automation platforms that turn AI into governed enterprise workflows. This is research support only, not a buy/sell recommendation. Highest-priority direct exposures in this pass are Microsoft, Amazon, Alphabet, Salesforce, and ServiceNow. Key evidence to verify next: AI-specific revenue disclosure quality, cloud gross-margin drag from AI infrastructure, Copilot/Agentforce/Now Assist seat or ACV expansion, RPO/cRPO contribution, renewal and net retention impact, and whether AI features create switching costs versus simply raising compute cost.
